QUAD 606 · POWER AMPLIFIER

Restoring your Quad 606

The Quad 606 is a powerful amplifier that drives your loudspeakers. There are two main versions, MK I and MK II. The Quad 707 and 909 are close relatives and use the same DADA kit.

This guide is new. Nobody has checked its parts list against a real Quad 606 yet, so treat it as a starting point.

Before anything else: stay safe

This power amplifier plugs into the mains. Parts inside can still give you a dangerous shock after it is unplugged.

If you are new to electronics, don't open it. You can do everything on this page from the outside. A qualified technician does the work inside.

Four steps

1

Write down a few details

You can find all of these from the outside.

  • The serial number.
  • The shape of the case: square edges or chamfered (angled) edges. Square is usually MK I and chamfered is MK II. But square cases with serials 19,900 to 21,600 are MK IIs.
  • Your preamplifier.
  • Whether it hums mechanically from inside the case.
2

Talk it through with an AI assistant

An AI assistant with the Quad Agent guide checks your details against Quad's own documents and tells you what applies to your Quad 606. It asks questions first and never guesses part values.

Copy this into your AI assistant:

Read quad-upgrade/SKILL.md and follow it to help me restore my Quad 606. Start by helping me identify it from the outside.

It needs the guide files first. Download the guide and add it to your assistant, or give it the quad-upgrade folder.

3

Choose what you want done

The recap

A recap replaces the ageing capacitors on the amplifier boards and the big ones that store power. On a MK I, DADA also updates a few input parts to match the MK II and replaces the internal wiring.

Optional extras

These change how the Quad 606 behaves. You don't need any of them.

  • Lower sensitivity. Changing one resistor per channel makes the 606 need a stronger signal, which suits many modern preamps.
  • Quieter transformer. If the 606 hums mechanically, the usual cure is DADA's kit with a different kind of transformer. That is mains wiring and a technician's job.
4

Take it to a technician

Send them the link to this page. Everything they need is in the section below: the parts list, Quad's service documents and the upgrade guides.

Ask them to check the parts against your actual Quad 606 before ordering. Quad changed things during production, and earlier owners may have too.

Good to know

  • The big capacitors hold a lot of energy after you switch off. Only a technician should open it.
  • Never connect loudspeakers until the technician's checks are done.
